notes.base_url: null = auto-resolve from APP_PORT (env var or repo .env). Set explicitly to override.
notes.test_timeout_seconds: Hard cap for one `run_tests.py` invocation; a slower run is treated as a harness crash.
notes.coding_agent_command: CLI executable for auto-repair; the repair prompt is piped to its stdin. Swap for any agent CLI, e.g. 'codex' with coding_agent_args ['exec'].
notes.coding_agent_args: Arguments passed before stdin. Default lets Claude Code edit files headlessly; the autopilot handles testing/rollback itself.
notes.coding_agent_timeout_seconds: Hard cap per repair attempt; also clamped to the remaining runtime budget at call time.
notes.max_runtime_minutes: Hard wall-clock ceiling for the whole run. Override with --max-runtime-minutes.
notes.max_same_failure_attempts: Stop if a single failure category survives this many repair rounds. Override with --max-same-failure-attempts.
notes.stop_if_no_improvement_rounds: Stop after this many consecutive rounds that did not improve the score. Override with --stop-if-no-improvement-rounds.
notes.fresh_backend_verify: After a kept fix, cold-restart a self-started backend and retest to confirm the fix survives a clean start (not just uvicorn auto-reload). Skipped for user-started backends; disable with --no-fresh-backend-verify.
notes.auto_commit: Commit kept repairs (runtime logs/ are always excluded from autopilot commits).
notes.rollback_on_worse: git reset --hard to the pre-repair checkpoint when results get worse or do not improve.
notes.usage: Copy to agent/config.json to override; config.json wins over this example file.
